description.narrative: Det huvudsakliga målet med insatsen är att bidra till fattigdomsminskning och livsmedelssäkerhet genom effektivare policies och program för jordbruk och landsbygdsutveckling, baserat på relevanta, tillförlitliga och uppdaterade data om jordbrukssektorn.

The main objective of the progject is contribution to poverty reduction and food security through more effective agriculture and rural development policies and programme defined and implemented on the basis of relevant, reliable and up-to-date structural data on the agriculture sector for their interventions.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Several results have been achieved the implementation. The first major result was the approval of the National Census of Agriculture (NCA) sub-decree in January 2013. The NCA sub-decree indicated the start of the census to April 2013. Furthermore, relevant committees and working groups where established for conducting the census. International technical assistance was provided through FAO for preparatory activities. Since then data collection, analysis and dissemination has been made. A draft report on the census was disseminated to stakeholders in August 2014 and a final version of the census report is expected during the first half of 2015. The statistics and analysis in the report is expected to provide useful information for agriculture sector stakeholders in Cambodia.
